name: CreateCloudResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The TLS version to add. This parameter is used only when **HttpsPorts** is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:
- **tlsv1**
- **tlsv1.1**
- **tlsv1.2**
fields.help_zh:
要添加的TLS版本。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：
- **tlsv1**
- **tlsv1.1**
- **tlsv1.2**
fields.name: tls_version

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether TLS 1.3 is supported. This parameter is used only when **HttpsPorts** is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:

- **true**: TLS 1.3 is supported.

- **false**: TLS 1.3 is not supported
fields.help_zh:
是否支持TLS1.3版本。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **true**：表示支持TLS1.3版本。

- **false**：表示不支持TLS1.3版本
fields.name: enable_tlsv3

fields.help_en:
The type of cipher suite to add. This parameter is used only when **HttpsPorts** is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:

- **1**: all cipher suites.

- **2**: strong cipher suites. This value is available only when **TLSVersion** is set to **tlsv1.2**.

- **99**: custom cipher suites
fields.help_zh:
要添加的加密套件类型。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **1**：表示添加全部加密套件。

- **2**：表示添加强加密套件。仅**TLSVersion**取值为**tlsv1.2**时，可选择该取值。

- **99**：表示添加自定义加密套件
fields.name: cipher_suite

fields.help_en: The specific custom cipher suites to add. This parameter is used only when **CipherSuite** is set to **99**
fields.help_zh: 要添加的具体自定义加密套件。仅**CipherSuite**配置为**99**时，使用该参数
fields.name: custom_ciphers

fields.help_en: The cloud service type
fields.help_zh: 云产品类型
fields.name: resource_product

fields.help_en: The port of the cloud service connected to WAF
fields.help_zh: 接入WAF的云产品端口
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The ID of the cloud service instance
fields.help_zh: 云产品实例的ID
fields.name: resource_instance_id

fields.help_en: The protocol type
fields.help_zh: 协议类型
fields.name: protocol

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the certificate to add.

> You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718120.html to query the IDs of all SSL certificates associated with the cloud service instance
element_fields.help_zh:
要添加的证书的ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718120.html查询云产品实例关联的所有SSL证书的ID
element_fields.name: certificate_id

element_fields.help_en:
The certificate type for HTTPS. Valid values:

- **default**: default certificate.

- **extension**: extended certificate
element_fields.help_zh:
HTTPS协议的证书类型。取值：

- **default**：表示默认证书。

- **extension**：表示拓展证书
element_fields.name: applied_type

fields.help_en: The list of certificate IDs
fields.help_zh: 证书ID列表
fields.name: certificates

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2. This parameter is used only when **HttpsPorts** is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:

- **true**: HTTP/2 is enabled.

- **false** (default): HTTP/2 is not enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启HTTP2。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **true**：表示开启HTTP2。

- **false**（默认）：表示不开启HTTP2
fields.name: http2_enabled

fields.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud service.



> This parameter is required when the instance ID to be connected has not been synchronized to WAF
fields.help_zh:
云产品归属地域ID。



> 要接入的实例ID，未同步到WAF时，此参数必须输入
fields.name: resource_region_id

fields.help_en:
The domain name connected to WAF.
> This parameter is required only when the cloud service type is ddos. For other service types, leave this field empty
fields.help_zh:
接入 WAF 的域名。
> 仅当云产品类型为ddos时，必填；其余产品类型，该字段为空
fields.name: domain

element_fields.help_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The value of the custom request header field
element_fields.help_zh: 自定义请求头部字段设定的值
element_fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The value of this parameter is in the format of [**{"k":"_key_","v":"_value_"}**], where **_key_** specifies the custom request header field and **_value_** specifies the value of the field.

> If the custom header field already exists in the request, the system overwrites the value of the field with the specified traffic mark value
fields.help_zh:
该参数值的格式为[**{"k":"_key_","v":"_value_"}**]。其中，**_key_**表示所指定的自定义请求头部字段，**_value_**表示为该字段设定的值。

> 如果请求中已存在该自定义头部字段，系统将用所设定的流量标记值覆盖请求中该自定义字段的值
fields.name: request_headers

fields.help_en:
The method that WAF uses to obtain the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:

- **0**: No Layer 7 proxy is deployed in front of WAF.

- **1**: WAF reads the first value of the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header field as the client IP address.

- **2**: WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify as the client IP address
fields.help_zh:
WAF获取客户端真实IP的方式。取值：

- **0**：表示客户端访问流量到WAF前没有经过其他七层代理转发。

- **1**：表示WAF读取请求头中X-Forwarded-For（XFF）字段的第一个值作为客户端IP。

- **2**：表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP
fields.name: xff_header_mode

fields.help_en:
The list of custom header fields used to obtain the client IP address, in the format of [**"header1","header2",……**].

> This parameter is required only when **XffHeaderMode** is set to 2, which indicates that WAF reads the value of a custom header field as the client IP address
fields.help_zh:
设置用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表，使用[**"header1","header2",……**]格式表示。

> 仅在**XffHeaderMode**取值为2（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，需要设置该参数
fields.name: xff_headers

fields.help_en:
The read timeout period. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 3600
fields.help_zh:
读超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600
fields.name: read_timeout

fields.help_en:
The write timeout period. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 3600
fields.help_zh:
写超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600
fields.name: write_timeout

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable persistent connections. Valid values:

- **true** (default): Persistent connections are enabled.

- **false**: Persistent connections are not enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否保持长连接。取值：

- **true**（默认）：表示保持长连接。

- **false**：表示不保持长连接
fields.name: keepalive

fields.help_en:
The number of requests that reuse persistent connections. Valid values: 60 to 1000.

> After persistent connections are enabled, this parameter specifies how many requests can reuse persistent connections
fields.help_zh:
复用长连接的请求个数。取值范围：60~1000，单位：个。

> 开启长连接后，复用多少个长连接
fields.name: keepalive_requests

fields.help_en:
The idle timeout period for persistent connections. Valid values: 10 to 3600. Default value: 3600. Unit: seconds.

> Specifies how long an idle persistent connection can remain open before it is released
fields.help_zh:
空闲长连接超时时间，取值范围：10~3600，默认3600，单位：秒。

> 复用的长连接空闲多久后释放
fields.name: keepalive_timeout

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use X-Forward-For-Proto to pass the protocol used by WAF. Valid values:

- **true** (default): The protocol used by WAF is passed.

- **false**: The protocol used by WAF is not passed
fields.help_zh:
X-Forward-For-Proto 传递WAF的协议。取值：

- **true**（默认）：表示传递WAF的协议。

- **false**：表示不传递WAF的协议
fields.name: xff_proto

fields.help_en:
The maximum request body size. Valid values: 2 to 10. Default value: 2. Unit: GB.
> Only Ultimate Edition is supported
fields.help_zh:
最大请求体大小。取值范围：2~10，默认值：2，单位：G。
> 仅旗舰版支持
fields.name: max_body_size

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The UID that indicates the resource ownership
parameters.name: owner_user_id
